test_P10Tokenizer_tokenize: test the P10Tokenizer tokenize method to convert floats to digit tokens with sign and exponent
test_P10Tokenizer_representation_range: test the P10Tokenizer representation range by verifying min and max absolute values for given digit and exponent configs
test_P10Tokenizer_tokenization_limit: test the P10Tokenizer tokenization limit behavior for edge cases near overflow and underflow boundaries
test_IEEEFloatTokenizer_tokenize: test the IEEEFloatTokenizer tokenize method to convert floats to sign-mantissa-exponent digit tokens
test_NormalizedTokenizer_tokenize: test the NormalizedTokenizer tokenize method to convert floats in [0,1] to base-N digit sequences
test_AddSpecialValues_tokenize: test the AddSpecialValues wrapper tokenizer to handle NaN, Inf, and INVALID float values
test_AppendPadTokenizer_to_tokens: test the AppendPadTokenizer wrapper to append a pad token after each tokenized object
